coverage_issues: The qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO and .nvchecker.toml due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) to prevent individual file audit failures from cascading into an inconclusive package verdict.
